summary: View A Batch Genealogy Report Showing The Complete Lineage From Raw Ma

acceptanceCriteria.text: The user can access the "Batch Information Cockpit" or equivalent genealogy Fiori app.
The user can search by finished goods batch number to view all consumed component batches and their originating vendors.
The system displays the full where-used chain if the finished batch was further processed or repackaged.
The report includes relevant dates: manufacturing, in-process control results, and release date.
The report can be exported for inclusion in a regulatory recall response or customer quality inquiry.
The system returns genealogy results within an acceptable time frame to support time-critical recall investigations.

HP.description: View genealogy for a finished goods batch with single-level BOM
View genealogy for a finished goods batch with multi-level BOM (raw → intermediate → finished)
View where-used chain for a batch that was further processed (finished → repackaged)
Export genealogy report to file (PDF or Excel)

AP.description: Search by batch number without specifying material (system derives material)
Search with both component view and where-used view enabled (bidirectional genealogy)

NEG.description: Search by non-existent finished goods batch number
Search by batch number in wrong format (invalid characters or length)
Access Batch Information Cockpit without required authorization
Search by batch that has no component batches (never consumed anything)

ERR.description: Export fails due to system authorization or technical error

EDGE.description: Genealogy query with maximum BOM depth (10+ levels)
Genealogy query for batch with hundreds of component batches (complex assembly)
Query genealogy at exactly the acceptable time threshold
Batch with incomplete dates (e.g., released but no inspection date recorded)

INT.description: Verify vendor batch number linkage from MM goods receipt to PP batch genealogy
Verify inspection lot results from QM appear in genealogy report
